Scoping belongs in .editorconfig itself wherever it can be expressed

$comment_Disable: IndentSize checks that left-padding is a multiple of indent_size, which
flags ruff-format's own docstring and comment prose continuations (the
hanging-indent continuation lines in __init__.py, ssh.py and others).
ruff-format already fully governs Python indentation, so this check has
nothing to add and 19 false positives to contribute. indent_style,
end_of_line, trailing whitespace and final newline all stay on.
